candidates.hook: Clarissa smugly reveals 'Because he is marrying me' while holding Gerald's hand at the altar.
candidates.cliffhanger: Clarissa delivers the brutal blow: 'Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.'
candidates.why: Establishes immediate high-stakes altar betrayal with clear villains and cuts on a cruel, lingering line.

candidates.hook: Matriarch harshly cuts Juliana off with 'Enough! You have embarrassed this family long enough.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Gerald arrogantly declares he cannot marry a woman of 'low value' like Juliana just as her hand clenches in fury.
candidates.why: Highlights the extreme family betrayal and emotional cruelty, driving high engagement from viewers eager for revenge.

candidates.hook: Juliana screams 'You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!' and Gerald coldly replies 'I changed my mind.'
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana begs her silent father for help, only for the Matriarch to yell 'Enough! You have embarrassed this family long enough.'
candidates.why: Combines the shock of the groom's cold abandonment with the heartbreak of her father's silence.

moments.desc: Clarissa gloats 'Because he is marrying me' as Juliana gasps in devastation.
Juliana cries out in her mother's gown, and Gerald coldly responds 'I changed my mind.'
Juliana drops to her knees begging her father, who refuses to look at her.
Gerald calls Juliana low value and plain before turning his back on her.
